notablePrerequisites:
You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
You are currently venturing in "Tomb of Annihilation" in the "Veils of Fear" room.
easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two other nontoken creatures.
You have the highest life total.
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, causing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast [[Permanent with ETB: "Exile a creature" and LTB: "Return exiled creature to BF" (Banish Creature)|banisher]] by paying its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Radiant Solar and two other nontoken creatures until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Glorious Protector and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land or lose 2 life.
Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, returning Radiant Solar and the two other nontoken creatures from exile to the battlefield.
Radiant Solar and the two creatures enter the battlefield, triggering Radiant Solar three times.
Resolve the first Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a 4/4 The Atropal legendary creature token, and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Glorious Protector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Radiant Solar and two other nontoken creatures until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the "Trapped Entry" room of the Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the second Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to lose 2 life unless they discard a card.
Repeat from step 4.
